label: NT Phase 3
info:
Phase 2 + Device UID lookup: Spark → Node-RED → AI Summary → Resolve UID via NQL → Nexthink Remote Action (Rescue Calling Card)

Pipeline:
1. Spark POSTs escalation to /nexthink/rescue
2. Extract payload (cmdb_ci as DEVICE NAME, caller_id, description, work_notes, etc.)
3. Respond 200 to Spark immediately with ticketId + ticketNumber
4. Validate input
5. Send description + work_notes to OpenAI for summarization (<=500 chars)
6. Get Nexthink auth token
7. Resolve device NAME → collector.uid via NQL
8. Trigger remote action #escalate_spark_to_rescue_remote with the summary
9. Log response

Env vars expected:
  OPENAI_API_KEY                    - OpenAI API key
  OPENAI_MODEL                      - optional, defaults to gpt-5.4-mini
  NEXTHINK_REMOTE_ACTION_ID         - optional, defaults to #escalate_spark_to_rescue_remote
  NEXTHINK_NQL_DEVICE_LOOKUP_ID     - optional, defaults to #resolve_device_uid_by_name
